practical_units.dissection_plane: Superficial plane beneath anterior deltoid fibers
practical_units.observation: Cadavéric specimen demonstrates three distinct muscular insertion facets on the greater tubercle: superior (supraspinatus), middle (infraspinatus), and inferior (teres minor).

practical_units.dissection_plane: Deep posterior plane inferior to teres minor, superior to teres major
practical_units.observation: Axillary nerve and posterior circumflex humeral vessels pass through the quadrangular space directly adjacent to the posterior aspect of the humeral surgical neck.

practical_units.dissection_plane: Beneath acromion and coracoacromial ligament, above rotator cuff tendons
practical_units.observation: Subacromial-subdeltoid bursal space provides low-friction plane separating the suprahumeral arch from the underlying supraspinatus tendon.

practical_units.dissection_plane: Intertubercular sulcus bounded by greater and lesser tubercles
practical_units.observation: Long head of biceps tendon is retained inside the bicipital groove by the overlying transverse humeral ligament during rotational maneuvers.

practical_units.dissection_plane: Fibrous layer spanning between crest of greater and lesser tubercles
practical_units.observation: Transverse humeral ligament acts as an osteofibrous retinaculum bridging the sulcus and preventing biceps tendon displacement.
